title: Gaban
desc: An unemployed son of an honest clerk tries to use his charm to con his way to a better life.

title: Suhana Safar
desc: Enticed by his poetry, Sapna travels to India from the USA to meet poet Ujjwala. She meets a man, Sunil, who falls for her but decides to help her reach him in Phulwari.

title: Naya Daur
desc: When the son of a landlord decides to modernize his business by replacing the horse carts with buses, a horse cart rider decides to challenge him.

title: Budkaar
desc: Mini, a young woman, is kidnapped from a pub and police investigate the case. However, when her sister sets out to find her, she uncovers a criminal nexus which shakes the city.

title: Param Dharam
desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.
